comments.name: Cole
comments.text:
Apple doesn’t have a multi stream cuda scheduler. MLX/Metal inference engines typically run on one kernel queue. 

NVIDIA does have a multi-stream CUDA scheduler. CUDA inference engines can launch many concurrent kernel streams across the GPU, so multiple models, batches, or users execute in parallel while the hardware scheduler interleaves warps and tensor-core work to keep the GPU fully utilized.
